shared_rules.source_basis: Accepted A–C owns the required meaning. D supplies the corresponding real source value to that consumer; a source listing alone supplies no value.
shared_rules.identity: Retain source occurrences and original identifiers. Instrument identity includes issuer/office, type and adopted number/date; proposal numbers, register occurrences and document renditions remain distinct. Cross-source joins require a relationship supported by the sources, never names, repeated native IDs or coordinate proximity alone.
shared_rules.temporal: Keep event, legal effect, publication and acquisition/knowledge time separate at source precision. Distinguish proposal, issue, transmission, receipt, publication commencement/completion, actual work and later record insertion where the consumer does. Corrections identify the same affected fact/context and predecessor; chronology alone does not prove replacement. Conflicting contemporaneous values remain unresolved until supported adjudication.
shared_rules.cadence: Retain publisher release cadence and observed acquisition time per source. Recheck mutable source status before a new time-sensitive conclusion; do not treat a captured baseline as a live subscription or infer an update interval from silence.
shared_rules.population: A complete published population and a complete real-world required population are independently qualified. Known acquisition omissions cannot be certified complete.
shared_rules.access: Retain rights/access metadata and enforce controlled-source permission at the evidence reader. A public form proves format, not instance performance.
shared_rules.correction: Repair the source-owned fact and every affected dependent conclusion while preserving the original source and historical knowledge view. Do not use last-writer wins.
shared_rules.composition: Listed contracts are evidence routes contributing to a predicate, not additional universal conjunctions. C controls decisive branch composition; absent irrelevant evidence cannot block a resolved branch.

contracts.claim: The delivered cadastral feature and its qualified parcel correspondence are established.
contracts.grain: one municipality/release/GML feature occurrence; source identifiers may repeat
acquisition_routes: AdE regional bulk municipal GML release
contracts.sufficiency: Preserve every source occurrence, including repeated gml:id/national references with different geometry. Join to case annexes through qualified municipality/sheet/parcel correspondence; a later cadastral release does not establish historical case geometry. EPSG6706 GML uses its stated axis order; do not assume longitude,latitude. A source-reference comparison enumerates its actual components. Matching municipality/section/sheet/parcel does not fill missing annex/development, identify a whole parcel from a portion, or establish physical succession. Preserve original/definitive reference roles and source-native repetitions; a missing reference in a later release or bounded query is not a suppression or title-transfer act.
contracts.absence: A missing polygon does not negate the source case parcel or establish its owner. A general 2m accuracy description is not a guaranteed error bound.

contracts.claim: The bounded holiday calendar and any qualified exceptional counting context apply to this clock.
contracts.grain: one calendar jurisdiction and bounded date interval with source-rule versions
acquisition_routes: official national holiday legislation and amendments
competent local holiday evidence where applicable
contracts.sufficiency: C owns ordinary counting conventions. Supply holidays for the entire interval the calculation may traverse, with source-effective dates; no calendar beyond its proven coverage. Working contact hours do not determine legal working days.
contracts.absence: Missing local or exceptional evidence cannot become an arbitrary override. Identify the affected clock/calendar interval.

contracts.claim: The legal event and knowledge cutoff of this evaluation.
contracts.grain: one evaluation of one coherent plant, area, work or occasion context
acquisition_routes: event source under the applicable event contract
contracts.sufficiency: The legal event date selects A/B. Sampling, reporting, adoption, publication and notification dates remain different. A date-only source cannot establish an exact instant. Query context is not proof of an event.
contracts.absence: Require the missing event or its precision only for computations using it.

run_input.rule: The run request states the evaluation context; no parameter has a default. The event date selects the A/B version. The knowledge cutoff has one meaning: what the corpus held, and the same instant is C's evaluated_at. The readers that apply it admit only sources captured at or before it: laboratory reports, their associations and the report routes in findings, removal-order originals, postings, held events and liveness closures by captured_at <= known_through in the source map's acquisition records; the held-act texts D reads as evidence of stated changes, which have no acquisition record, by the latest commit that added them. Supplied records carry no capture time, so their own dates bound them: one whose occurred, complete_from or complete_through is later than the cutoff is refused. The monitoring observation stream is not filtered by the cutoff: a join or confirmation request is refused while any retained monitoring release was captured after it. Each event's own date stays with that event's contract.

contracts.claim: A particular administrative or legal state is established at the relevant event time.
contracts.grain: one instrument/version, operative proposition and territorial/case scope
fields: supersession/correction/annulment basis, including whether a court disposition annuls the act on its stated ground for public posting
acquisition_routes: BURP and signed regional/national/EU primary acts
contracts.sufficiency: Read the actual operative clause and adopted annexes against accepted A. An applicable policy may establish exercised retention without inventing a further individual authorization. Later summaries and a title alone do not establish payload or legal effect. Identify the actual affected scope and event time of corrections, revocations and judicial outcomes; preserve unaffected predecessor propositions. Same-number or later same-subject records do not establish a replacement relation, and an empty appeal search does not establish permanent finality.
contracts.absence: Source absence is not annulment, refusal or failure. Resolve the exact missing act, annex or effect basis.

contracts.claim: The particular act governs the stated work population and recipient positions.
contracts.grain: one source-annex occurrence linked to its instrument and case
fields: stated commencement term as printed (number and unit word), the coercive population and the executor
acquisition_routes: original BURP prescription and complete annexes
contracts.sufficiency: Read original clauses and preserve each annex occurrence. A partial-parcel intersection is not a plant census; several listed positions are not necessarily distinct people. Old generic Article 7/13 classifications and default state columns are not admitted as legal or event facts. Governing A references name every accepted A row of the instrument and every correction or supplement naming it.
contracts.absence: Missing annex relations remain unresolved; do not turn an omitted row into exclusion from the lawful plant population.

contracts.claim: The exact recipient-effect or publication event is established through the applicable route.
contracts.grain: one act, recipient or legally defined recipient cohort, and notice/publication occurrence
fields: the act's own stated ground for public posting, verbatim with its page, kept apart from a recital restating Article 21-bis and from a plan instruction; and the publicity form the act states: place, and the period as printed (number and unit word)
acquisition_routes: municipal albo entry and publication attestation
competent act selecting publicity or immediate-effect route
contracts.sufficiency: Apply accepted A to the actual completed route. A source instruction to publish, a BURP issue date or a planned channel does not prove municipal publication or individual delivery. Acknowledgement is evidence where appropriate, not a new universal legal condition. Interpret date fields against the source’s actual meaning: an archive retention horizon is not completed legal publication. Use the original publication certificate when available; preserve a stated start even if completion remains unknown. An archived observation before a displayed end cannot certify an uninterrupted completed period. Preserve whether a document match is source-stated or an inferred candidate, and whether the posted attachment itself was acquired. Municipal receipt of a general circular does not establish case-specific recipient notice.
contracts.absence: No public notice record does not establish no notice; obtain the attestation or recipient evidence.

contracts.claim: An actual election, refusal or qualified absence of communication concerns this recipient and work.
contracts.grain: one recipient/work communication occurrence; absence over a bounded complete history
contracts.sufficiency: C applies the correct window to qualifying actual responses, including valid early election. No-response requires a complete bounded history or explicit qualified attestation, not an archive default or an empty public table.
contracts.absence: Missing communications and evidence of no communication remain distinct.

contracts.claim: The identified person or position bears the case-relevant relationship to the land at the event time.
contracts.grain: one evidence-backed party/parcel/role occurrence and interval
fields: source-stated right and share, with absent unit or denominator explicit
whole/part scope and source accounting or procedural status
contracts.sufficiency: An annex establishes the published position it states. Current ownership/control needs its appropriate evidence. Names alone do not resolve identity; a cadastral polygon does not establish title or occupier authority. Municipal inventory inclusion, cadastral designation, state-property title, civic-use status, concession and actual control are distinct source statements. Preserve their original roles, portions, dates and share semantics. A municipal percentage is not automatically an exclusive title share. Published future tenders, withdrawn awards, expired arrangements and taken-back property do not establish a present concession merely because the row is newly published. Competing source positions require their title-effective or case-specific evidence; neither dataset recency nor a name match determines the responsible recipient.
contracts.absence: Preserve unresolved party identity while retaining independently established parcel and finding facts.

contracts.claim: A finding or published analytical observation is established at its actual scope and level.
contracts.grain: one official finding or source observation, with its plant/sample/report context
acquisition_routes: CAMP workbooks and SIT observation records
contracts.sufficiency: An official act explicitly establishing an infected plant can supply that fact directly. A CAMP result supplies its published result label; it does not independently prove each assay, pool decomposition or official-confirmation condition. Asymptomatic is not uninfected. A new report can qualify the same finding more deeply.
contracts.absence: Unobserved, unreported and negative are different. Preserve useful established findings despite missing deeper analytical fields.

contracts.claim: The actual analytical result and method/identity qualifications required by this consumer are established.
contracts.grain: one assay/run or signed report result for an identified sample, extract or pool
fields: result/Cq as exact decimal or explicit no-Cq
acquisition_routes: public official laboratory reports linked by SIT
official diagnostic procedures and applicable method documentation
contracts.sufficiency: Use report-stated method/result qualifications and source-native identities. Method name alone does not establish a different genome target; assay counts are not independent sampled units. C owns Cq boundaries and repeat logic. A procedure defines the record requirement, not actual test performance. An attributable nonofficial report may establish its own reported result and reporting trigger; it does not establish official-control status or official confirmation.
contracts.absence: Acquire linked public reports before classifying deeper inputs as controlled. Missing Cq does not erase a sufficient official finding.

contracts.claim: Source-required recognition, designation and qualification cover the exact task/method at the event time.
contracts.grain: one laboratory facility, source-required status route and exact task/method scope over an interval
acquisition_routes: official recognition/designation acts and SFN/INRPP lists
contracts.sufficiency: Qualification follows the exact A route. General laboratory presence or accreditation does not prove every method. A current list cannot silently supply a historical status; later independent evidence may establish later operation without resolving original commencement.
contracts.absence: No discovered suspension is not a complete no-suspension history. Scope missingness to the actual qualification required.

contracts.claim: The responsible individual is qualified and assigned for the particular official activity.
contracts.grain: one personnel identity, legal role, assignment and event interval
contracts.sufficiency: The actual role and task matter; authority to assist does not create authority to prescribe. Read source-required signature and supervision distinctions without inventing a wider personnel workflow. Published assignment descriptions support their stated remit and qualified interval; a potentially presumed end is not a proven cessation. A CV, current role description and historical appointment/correction original are distinct evidence. Conditional substitution requires the condition only when that attribution is material; no blanket appointment-file prerequisite is added to every official measure.
contracts.absence: Missing proof is not a proven personnel-authority defect.

contracts.claim: The particular adoption, opinion, request, transmission or other required administrative performance occurred.
contracts.grain: one event and payload tied to a particular instrument, programme, request or task
fields: source-established actor knowledge/awareness date where the exact consumer requires it
acquisition_routes: published official acts, programmes and minutes
contracts.sufficiency: A duty to act is not performance. Preserve the particular source-native requirement: successful reporting may be evidenced by an acknowledgement without making that format an added legal condition. Include only events directly affecting this decision chain. A report issue date is not its recipient receipt or a particular person’s awareness; those require the particular source payload. Monitoring an emergency plan is an administrative performance about that plan, distinct from field survey observations. Application, recognition referral, opinion, express grant, source-stated absence of an opinion and actual record receipt remain distinct events. Read incorporated originals when a summary conflicts, and retain source-attributed discrepancies rather than silently rewriting every date.
contracts.absence: Missing published event does not prove nonperformance; obtain the particular record or bounded history.

contracts.claim: The operative area, partition or geographical relationship is established for the proper version and scope.
contracts.grain: one source feature occurrence plus dataset/release and adopting instrument where applicable
acquisition_routes: SIT current and historical feature services
InnovaPuglia adopted shapefiles supplied to Osservatorio/ARIF
qualified land geometry for the island consumer
contracts.sufficiency: Separate source feature completeness from operative geographic completeness. A public 1ha layer is not automatically the full regional operative grid. Bind features to the adopting act and event time. Preserve disjoint components and holes. Numeric C ground-distance claims require qualified spatial error; EPSG or coordinate decimals do not supply it.
contracts.absence: Direct official area statements can remain useful when a numeric distance cannot yet be qualified. Never fabricate a grid, adopted boundary or zero-error ground coordinate.

contracts.claim: The relevant plants, host qualifications or land units and their completeness are established.
contracts.grain: one plant/inspection-unit occurrence within an explicitly defined required population
acquisition_routes: official field inventory and geolocated plant records
validated observation-derived inventories with stated limitations
published device accuracy tests, the monitoring device procurement and ISTAT's regional boundary, for the positional qualification of a location
contracts.sufficiency: Required populations follow A and C, not the available dataset. A sample ID, tree-crown candidate and legally identified plant are different evidential identities. A complete monitoring download or parcel list is not a complete required-plant census. Source-qualified estimates remain estimates.
contracts.absence: Unknown members or inventory incompleteness affect universal/all-member conclusions, not a separately identified positive plant.

positional_qualification.stated: cordon_d.spatial.positional_qualification: the horizontal error of a located monitoring observation's recorded position, the plant's location, against its true position on the ground, stated in EPSG:32633. The error is the stated device term plus the grid distortion over the longest distance a C consumer bound to plant-population measures from the location, found by enumerating those consumers and the B widths they read, with the scale bounded from the Transverse Mercator definition over Puglia's official extent widened by that distance; no map error and no locality enter it. The device term is a stated device-class accuracy and was not measured on these fixes. No record states its device or capture mode.

replacing_input.applies_to: one fix, or one device class and capture mode, stated per record
one_of: ARIF's per-fix horizontal accuracy, or the device and capture mode (GNSS fix or map placement), per record
a bound measured from independent re-samples of the same plant: another team, day or tablet, linked by ID_CAMPIONE
a calibration of the documented device and app on surveyed control points
fields: fix or device class and capture mode it applies to
statistic: per-fix estimate, 95% value or maximum
reference position and the reference's own error, where the method has one
replacing_input.default: none: until one is held, the stated device term stands and its basis says so

contracts.claim: The individual plant or site has the particular recognized or otherwise qualifying protection/value status.
contracts.grain: one source-qualified plant/site and cohort where relevant, qualification ground and status interval
fields: the tree's own list entry: its provisional approval act and first BURP publication date, its definitive approval act and BURP republication date, and its deletion act and date

the plant's L.R. 14/2007 Article 2 monumental characteristics from its official monitoring record: the MONUMENTALE_ARIF flag printed as "Si" or "1", or the surveyor's written finding in NOTE_RILEVATORE that the plant has monumental characteristics, in any wording that asserts it (held examples: "caratteristiche di monumentalità", "caratteristiche monumentali", "requisiti di monumentalità", "carattere monumentale"), or a measurement the note records (the trunk diameter, and its height where stated)
value assessment if that ground applies
the Osservatorio's recognition-request record for the tree
acquisition_routes: the official monitoring record of the plant (MONUMENTALE_ARIF, NOTE_RILEVATORE)
the competent permission or decision reached by the affected protected plant and intervention
contracts.sufficiency: Provisional candidates do not become formally recognized trees. Apply the exact event-time Article 7 ground; recognition is not the only current ground. An applicable regional retention policy can supply the exercised choice for a qualifying individual. Qualify identity through the actual adopted cohort/list, survey/date and place/parcel context; published UM/COD or OID alone is insufficient where repeated. Definitive approval requires its source-established basis, not elapsed opposition time alone; registry deletion does not prove physical removal. Where landscape permission is required, establish the actual applicable procedure, authorized plant/site/intervention, issued decision and incorporated conditions. A referral, pending application, opinion, replant-only consent or a grant for another project cannot substitute for the required conclusion. Article 2 characteristics (Owen's ruling of 2026-09-24) are established by the plant's official monitoring record: the MONUMENTALE_ARIF flag printed as "Si" or "1", or the surveyor's written finding that the plant has monumental characteristics. The finding is named by its meaning: whether a note states it is D's reading of the record, and any wording that asserts it counts (held examples: "caratteristiche di monumentalità", "caratteristiche monumentali", "requisiti di monumentalità", "carattere monumentale"); a recorded measurement establishes them when it meets Article 2(1)(a) as A states it (PUG-LR14-2007:Art.2(1)(a):trunk-diameter-criterion). A register listing is not required for them.
contracts.absence: No registry match alone does not prove lack of every protection/value ground.

contracts.claim: The operative survey inputs are qualified for the actual target population and method.
contracts.grain: one campaign/area/host design and its disjoint strata
acquisition_routes: qualified validation and official methodological evidence
contracts.sufficiency: C owns formulas and finite-count conventions; B owns targets. Supply source-qualified current estimates and method scope. Do not substitute historical published estimates for future populations, .55 workload fit for universal sensitivity, or assay counts for inspected units.
contracts.absence: Unqualified method or population leaves the corresponding assurance claim unresolved while preserving workload and actual observations.

contracts.claim: Distinct usable observations and required survey occasions support the stated achieved-survey claim.
contracts.grain: one source observation or qualifying occasion within an explicit population and period
acquisition_routes: complete CAMP and live monitoring populations
actual survey reports and performance records
vector/host test reports and bounded official histories
contracts.sufficiency: Keep raw occurrences; deduplicate for a particular inspection-unit claim only with demonstrated identity. Public campaign absence may reflect survey allocation. Negative recurrence needs its own qualifying occasion and history, not multiple rows from one occasion.
contracts.absence: A known positive defeats a negative claim; an incomplete observation history does not prove no detection or omitted survey.

contracts.claim: The actual biological or environmental condition is established for this place and time.
contracts.grain: one bounded observation or qualified assessment of a relevant site/plant/vector population
acquisition_routes: applicable primary biological evidence and operative directions
contracts.sufficiency: Use the operative local evidence. A sentinel monitoring calendar is not actual flight season; an administrative treatment month does not prove vectors absent. A qualified official case determination can supply the qualitative input C deliberately leaves explicit.
contracts.absence: Missing vector observation is not absence. Confine unresolved biology to the treatment/timing or surveillance conclusion using it.

contracts.claim: The required vector/root/wood treatment actually occurred with the applicable qualifications.
contracts.grain: one treatment performance on an exact plant/population or area
acquisition_routes: actual official treatment and field records
qualified operator records verified under the operative procedure
contracts.sufficiency: A prescription or planned calendar is not treatment. C computes waiting and timing from actual qualified performance. Do not require continuous spraying to establish treatment during an applicable phase.
contracts.absence: Missing treatment evidence differs from proven omitted treatment; a resolved no-treatment route does not require an invented wait.

contracts.claim: Actual commencement, removal, destruction and verification are established for the exact required work.
contracts.grain: one actual operation/verification and the plant or surface population it covers
keys: App buffer code or corresponding source work key
acquisition_routes: App Xylella actual records under DDS45 documented form
contracts.sufficiency: The public form establishes an actual record format, not a completed operation. Preserve commencement, physical removal, permitted wood handling, verification and their times. Required member/scope coverage is separate from published-row completeness. Public source-derived expected-state columns cannot supply execution or noncommencement.
contracts.absence: Missing operation records are not nonexecution. Only a complete qualified history or affirmative evidence supports omission/noncommencement.

contracts.claim: The particular sample handoff and mandatory transport conditions are evidenced.
contracts.grain: one sample batch/handoff/receipt linked to constituent sample identities
acquisition_routes: actual App/paper handover and receipt records
DDS31/DDS45 documented custody procedure and forms
contracts.sufficiency: Preserve actual delivery and source-required signatures. The form defines fields; it does not prove transport occurred. A date-only same-day record can support a same-calendar-day claim without inventing an exact delivery instant for a different clock.
contracts.absence: Unknown delivery or refrigeration is not affirmative failure.

contracts.claim: The competent factual judgment or established legal consequence required by the exact predicate is available.
contracts.grain: one reasoned determination concerning a specific proposition and context
acquisition_routes: applicable policy supplying an exercised choice
source-grounded build-time adjudication for non-reserved evidence questions
contracts.sufficiency: Resolve supported in-actu choices during construction. Do not create operator model menus or demand individual authorization where an applicable policy supplies the choice. A proven defect affects the particular legal consequence established; missing paperwork is not automatically invalidity.
contracts.absence: Genuine load-bearing ambiguity remains named for Owen; reachable evidence is acquisition work.

contracts.claim: The narrow lawful-work and cost basis affecting this removal chain is established.
contracts.grain: one lawful execution work scope and competent cost determination
fields: primary obligor or proven offender as required
acquisition_routes: competent execution/cost determination and supporting work records
contracts.sufficiency: A duty to undertake substitute execution is not determined costs or a recovery right. Prospective lawful cost determination need not universally await completed work. This contract does not open grants, payments or the full penalty workflow.
contracts.absence: Missing cost records affect cost conclusions, not separately established removal duties.

contracts.claim: The requested evidence use follows the actual source access route and permission scope.
contracts.grain: one principal, requested evidence scope and access grant/route
acquisition_routes: official system documentation and authenticated custodian grants
contracts.sufficiency: Public evidence stays usable for its supported claims. A documented role/access route is not a claim that credentials or every backend export have been acquired. Do not expose controlled support through a public reader. A data-handler appointment and an actual system access grant have different scope; no replacement edge or current credential follows merely from a newer appointment title.
contracts.absence: Permission absence leaves that evidence unavailable without invalidating independent public evidence.

run_input.rule: The run states the controlled source identities its principal is granted; an empty grant is stated, never defaulted. A controlled record outside the grant reaches no C result and yields the need "authorized evidence for …". The grant record itself (access method and legal basis) is a first-party record, not a run input.

contracts.claim: The identified pest belongs to the operative source-listed legal category.
contracts.grain: one taxon and legal-list version at the event date
acquisition_routes: accepted source legal lists and official identification evidence
contracts.sufficiency: Use the exact event-time list and taxon identity; the source distinction does not expand the product to other pests.
contracts.absence: Unknown identification does not establish category membership.
